thesis: This episode argues that the future of media lies in immersive experiences like the metaverse and AR/VR, with companies like Epic and Tencent positioned to capitalize on these trends. It suggests that cloud gaming adoption is years away, making traditional gaming stocks less attractive, while highlighting the success of new categories like Fortnite and Minecraft. The thesis also emphasizes the importance of owning infrastructure and studios in the evolving gaming industry.
